name: Collateral 6
definition: Provides the current and market value of the collateral held.

PostHaircutValue.name: Post Haircut Value
PostHaircutValue.definition: Value of the collateral after deduction of a percentage (the haircut) that reflects the perceived risk associated with holding this collateral.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Value of the underlying collateral (cash, securities, Letter of credit.) based on current market prices.

CollateralType.name: Collateral Type
CollateralType.definition: Provides the type of collateral, such as securities or cash.
